## Magesty.jl

A Julia package for constructing general spin models using spin-cluster expansion.

- **Language:** Julia
- **Repository:** [Tomonori-Tanaka/Magesty.jl](https://github.com/Tomonori-Tanaka/Magesty.jl)
- **Documentation:** [tomonori-tanaka.github.io/Magesty.jl/dev](https://tomonori-tanaka.github.io/Magesty.jl/dev/)
- **Award:** Poster Award (2026)

---

## SpinClusterMC.jl

A Monte Carlo package for spin-cluster expansion models, derived from Magesty.jl.

- **Language:** Julia
- **Repository:** [Tomonori-Tanaka/SpinClusterMC.jl](https://github.com/Tomonori-Tanaka/SpinClusterMC.jl)
